title: Fintech stack — identity, accounts, transfers, clearing
summary: An in-memory financial-technology System Under Test covering identity, accounts, cards, transfers, currency, sanctions and clearing. Business rules are explicit, so order- and interaction-sensitive faults are decidable rather than approximate.

lifecycle.start: python -m finance_stack.gateway (loopback HTTP) — the harness starts it per campaign
lifecycle.stop: terminate the gateway process; the ledger is in memory and does not persist

determinism.reset: The ledger and identity stores are in-memory: restarting the gateway restores the documented opening balances.
determinism.seed: Scenario HEAD fixes the client identity, opening balances and instrument set; no random source participates in a verdict.

oracle.description: Conservation and authorization invariants over the ledger: value is neither created nor destroyed by a transfer, an unauthorized or sanctioned party cannot move funds, and a rejected operation leaves no partial effect.
oracle.independence: The invariants are evaluated over the ledger's observable end state by the scenario TAIL, not by the code that performed the operation — a handler that both moves money and declares the move correct cannot satisfy them by construction.

known_pass: A fully authorized intra-bank transfer within limits settles and conserves value
known_fail: A transfer from a sanctioned counterparty is rejected
A transfer exceeding the declared limit is rejected with no partial ledger effect

cleanup: Stop the gateway process; python generator_trunk/bundle_run.py cleanup <run-dir>.
caveats: The referenced harness is candidate code, not an automated test, and no workflow currently starts the required gateway and exercises it. This manifest is experimental until a bounded gate exists.
The generator_trunk/fintech_oot batches are a broader historical corpus and are deliberately NOT part of the canonical gated set.
